name: week
title: The site this week
subtitle: Read-only snapshot from the database. Demo records are fictional.

sections.title: Needs someone today
sections.note: Safety clocks first, then visits, money, documents and enrolment.
sections.sql: select item,protocol,record,owner,due_date,detail from v_attention order by case item when 'SAE CLOCK' then 1 when 'VISIT OVERDUE' then 2 when 'VISIT DUE' then 3 when 'INVOICE OVERDUE' then 4 when 'NOT INVOICED' then 5 else 6 end,due_date

sections.title: Visit windows in the next 14 days
sections.sql: select protocol,subject_number,visit,state,window_opens,window_closes,coordinator from v_visits where state in ('overdue','window open','upcoming') and participant_status in ('enrolled','screening') and coalesce(window_opens,scheduled_on)<=current_date+14 order by window_closes nulls last

sections.title: Enrolment
sections.sql: select protocol,sponsor,status,target,enrolled,should_have_by_now,screening,screen_failed,enrolment_closes_on from v_enrolment where status<>'closed' order by protocol

name: money
title: Sponsor money
subtitle: Earned and not invoiced, and invoices not yet paid.

sections.title: Totals by study
sections.sql: select protocol,sponsor,currency,state,count(*)::int as items,round(sum(amount_cents)/100.0) as amount from v_receivables group by protocol,sponsor,currency,state order by protocol,state

sections.title: Every item
sections.sql: select state,protocol,description,round(amount_cents/100.0) as amount,currency,since,days from v_receivables order by state,days desc

name: compliance
title: Record checks
subtitle: What the checks found against the rules in docs/compliance.md. Not legal or regulatory advice.

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select rule,protocol,record,finding,due_date,source from v_compliance order by rule,protocol
